title: Veiled in Mysterys Whisper
flavor: Veiled in Mystery's Whisper Within the halls of the Kara Chess Museum, whispers echo of ancient treasures lost... A wily phantom, adept at shrouding in disguise, has spirited away prized relics of bygone games. The curator, gathering whispers of clues, now beckons with bounteous promises, summoning adventurers from realms afar. Thus, warriors of valour embark upon a journey fraught with challenges, chasing shadows in pursuit of enigmatic lore.

entries.name: Now, in every game, 10 random $5 chess pieces will be shuffled into the legendary chess pool through which you can recruit. At the beginning of the game, only 5 of them will be revealed, and the rest of the legendary chess pieces will be revealed when a player recruits them for the first time. The player who reveals the legendary chess piece will receive a gold reward ($5 for the first one, decreasing by $1 for each subsequent one)
entries.detail: Note:  Only purchasing chess pieces from the recruitment panel counts as revealing them, while merely appearing on the recruitment panel does not. Note: Unrevealed legendary chess pieces will not be included in the cost of blocking chess pieces.

entries.name: After an away-home victory, non-permanent chess pieces (mirrors, summons, transformed chess pieces, etc.) deal half damage to the courier (with rounding-up rules unchanged, damage is at least 1 point)

entries.name: Storm Spirit - Ball Lightning
entries.detail: Flying speed decreased from 1250/1875/2500 to 1250/1500/1750 (may prevent it from escaping your own chess board), base damage increased from 40/60/100 to 50/75/125.

entries.name: Anti-Mage - Mana Break
entries.detail: Damage multiplier decreased from 5/7/10 to 4/6/8..

entries.name: Shaman - Hex
entries.detail: Adjusted from (2) (4) to (3) (6). (3) Shaman: All friendly Shaman chess pieces gain the effect: Transform into a random chess piece of +2 levels after casting an active skill or using an active item. (6) Shaman: Equipped items carried by transformed chess pieces will also transform into random items of +2 levels. Note: Transformed chess pieces' levels will not exceed the current level of the courier. Transformation takes 3 seconds to cast. Note: Hex does not transform non-permanent chess pieces, and they cease to be permanent chess pieces after transformation, lasting 15 to 20 seconds. Note: (3) Shaman does not inherit equipment after transformation.

entries.name: Shaman's class trait simplified to
entries.detail: Shaman chess pieces have -20% mana cost for skills. (Previously: Reduce 25% mana cost per transformation).

entries.name: New T3 Equipment
